name: Pathway Logging Implementation Template
description: Template for implementing thread-aware pathway logging in VSCode extension codebase

sections.title: Pathway Logging System
sections.content: Pathway logging tracks named execution threads through the application for collaborative debugging between human and AI. Each function declares its thread participation and logs key checkpoints.

items.description: A named execution flow through the system (e.g., TEMPLATE_LOADING, VALIDATION)
Point where multiple threads meet in a single function
Key point in execution that logs state and expectations

pattern.description: Add thread declaration to functions using threadspec comment

threads.name: TEMPLATE_LOADING
threads.description: Template file reading, parsing, and preparation

threads.name: AGENT_BRAIN
threads.description: Knowledge injection and AI agent interaction

rules.action: Log all intersecting threads, shared state
Log error, state at failure, recovery attempt

sections.title: Logger Enhancement
Integration Checklist
items: Add entry/exit checkpoints to thread-participating functions
Log thread intersections where multiple concerns meet
Add VSCode settings for pathway configuration
Add checkpoint() calls at state mutations

sections.title: Complete Integration Example
Best Practices
practices: Start with coarse checkpoints, refine based on debugging needs
Log data shapes, not full data (unless debugging specific issue)
Include timing information for performance analysis
Use correlation IDs to track requests across threads
Don't log sensitive data (passwords, tokens, PII)
Use thread intersections to identify complexity points

issues.solution: Use ThreadControl to activate only specific threads during debugging
Look for functions called by multiple features - these are natural intersection points
Use conditional logging based on active threads, log shapes not full objects
